headline: Frontline Turmoil Escalates Across Six Theatres
war_summary: Since the last edition three hours ago the tempo of base turnover has sharpened on the busiest fronts. Weathered Expanse remains the hottest sector, logging 48 ownership changes in the past day with colonial losses climbing to 9,656 and Warden losses to 15,500 while fresh enlistments rise to 552. Fishermans Row has surged to 46 flips, its casualties now at 635 colonial and 692 Warden dead and enlistments up 323. Stlican Shelf records 44 changes, colonial casualties adding 2,980 and Warden 2,763, enlistments 334. Callahans Passage shows 24 flips, the bloodiest theatre with 12,169 colonial and 14,107 Warden casualties in 24 hours and 790 new enlistees. Mooring County and Nevish Line each report nine flips; Mooring adds 3,865 colonial and 4,505 Warden dead with 599 enlistments, while Nevish adds 5,253 colonial and 4,797 Warden dead with 539 enlistments. Several quieter regions — Godcrofts, Linn Mercy, Marban Hollow, Palantine Berm and Stema Landing — have recorded a handful of changes, but the six sectors above dominate the strategic picture.
